      "explanation": "Radiographic, CNS, and photographic imaging at screening and EOT is time-consuming and burdensome; CNS imaging may not be needed for all patients.",

      "title": "Tight window for screening physical exam before first dose",
      "quote": "If the Screening full physical examination is performed > 72 hours before the W1D1 visit, then a brief (symptom directed) physical examination must be performed within 72 hours before the first injection of CMP-001.",
